In a stunning political upset, Democrats flipped Senate seats in traditionally Republican strongholds, with James Talarico defeating Trump-backed Ken Paxton in Texas, South Carolina electing its first Democratic senator since 1998, and Kansas sending a Democrat to the Senate for the first time since 1932. Democrats also claimed major victories in Iowa and Ohio. The results represent a dramatic rejection of Trump’s second-term agenda, with exit polls suggesting frustration over the cost of living played a major role. Actor Stacy Keach, best known for his roles in ‘Prison Break’ and ‘The Bourne Legacy’, has died aged 85. His death was confirmed by his wife, Małgosia Keach, who said he passed away at their family home in Poland on November 10 following a battle with a serious heart condition and heart failure. Keach enjoyed a career spanning more than six decades, earning a Tony Award nomination for his stage performance in ‘Indians’ and a Golden Globe nomination for playing detective Mike Hammer.
